payload.title: Newsroom: see and change a Story's scheduled time on its card and drawer
payload.description:
Part of the scheduled publishing and announcements epic. Design: docs/plans/scheduled-publishing-and-announcements.md ("Newsroom: the schedule on an item").

Goal: on a board card and in the Story drawer, an editor sees whether and when a Story is scheduled, and can schedule, change, suggest a time for, or unschedule it, beside the existing published state and Publish now button.

Shape: card badge (Lucide CalendarClock + "Thu 13 Nov, 09:00", AlertTriangle + "Overdue", CircleSlash + "Blocked: newer version"); drawer row "Scheduled for" with time, zone name and who scheduled; buttons Schedule…, Change time, Suggest a time, Unschedule; the editor's own zone in small type when different; no colour-only signals, no borders, no AppSync subscription. "Suggest a time" uses the slot suggestion learned from the publication's own cadence (hour-of-week counts and mean gap between first publications, each updated once per first publication).

Depends on: the scheduling backend story.

```gherkin
Feature: Editors see and change when a Story will go live
  An editor working the board needs to know at a glance what is scheduled and to
  move it without leaving the board.

  Scenario: A scheduled Story says when it will go live
    Given "Robots in the warehouse" is scheduled for 13 November at 09:00 New York time
    When Sam opens the board
    Then its card shows a calendar-clock icon and "Thu 13 Nov, 09:00"
    And the Story drawer says "Scheduled for Thu 13 Nov 2026, 09:00 New York, by Sam"

  Scenario: The state is readable without colour
    Given a scheduled card, an overdue card and a blocked card
    Then each shows its own icon and word: "Thu 13 Nov, 09:00", "Overdue" and "Blocked: newer version"

  Scenario: An editor in another zone sees both times
    Given Sam's browser is in Europe/London
    When Sam opens a Story scheduled for 09:00 New York time
    Then the drawer shows "09:00 New York" and, smaller, "14:00 your time"

  Scenario: Changing the time
    Given a Story scheduled for 13 November at 09:00
    When Sam changes it to 14 November at 07:30
    Then the drawer shows the new time
    And the old time will not publish it

  Scenario: Asking for a suggested time
    Given the publication usually publishes on weekday mornings about once a day
    And one Story is already scheduled for tomorrow at 08:00
    When Sam asks for a suggested time
    Then the picker offers the next weekday morning slot after tomorrow
    And Sam may pick any other time instead

  Scenario: No history, no suggestion
    Given a new publication with no published Stories
    When Sam asks for a suggested time
    Then the picker says "No suggestion yet: this publication has no publishing history."

  Scenario: A newer version is flagged straight away
    Given version 3 is scheduled
    When version 4 is saved
    Then the drawer says "A newer version exists than the one scheduled"

  Scenario: An unrated Story says what scheduling will and will not do
    Given an unrated Story
    When Sam schedules it
    Then the drawer says "Unrated: it will publish but will not be listed or announced until it is rated."
```

Open questions: none.
